chunks: And in the narration of Ḥarīz ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from him, عليه السلام, he said:
"It is not proper to enter the Ḥaram with a weapon unless he places it in a sack or conceals it, meaning until he wraps something around the iron."

key_terms.بِسِلَاحٍ: with a weapon; openly bearing arms
key_terms.جُوَالِقٍ: a sack or bag in which the weapon may be placed
key_terms.ٱلْحَدِيدِ: the iron of the weapon, meaning its blade or metal part
key_terms.ٱلْحَرَمَ: the sacred precinct in which special sanctity and restrictions apply

ai.seo_question: Can a person enter the Ḥaram while carrying a weapon?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a ruling on the etiquette and sanctity of entering the Ḥaram, forbidding the open carrying of weapons within it. If a weapon must be brought in, it should be covered or concealed so that its iron is wrapped and not openly displayed.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2332 - In a narration from Hariz ibn Abdullah, from him (Imam Abu Abdullah (as)):
"It is not appropriate to enter the Haram with a weapon unless it is placed in a sack or concealed - meaning, the blade should be wrapped in something."
